findings.title: Full-profile readiness can stay green after the required CDC/Postgres lane is dead
findings.claim: The full deployment profile enables CDC and depends on Postgres, but /readyz only gates on authorization, JWKS, Iggy and Electric; the CDC task logs failure without changing readiness.
evidence: openspec/changes/pri-c004-deployment-profiles/specs/production-readiness-integration/spec.md:10 requires semantic readiness with real dependency handshakes.
.kbd-orchestrator/phases/production-readiness-integration/evidence/pri-c003-scope-research-contract/release-contract.md:21 defines full topology with Postgres CDC.
compose.yml:45 enables CDC and compose.yml:46 points CDC_REPLICATION_URL at postgres.
crates/frf-gateway/src/routes/health.rs:78 computes all_ok from authorization, jwks, iggy and electric only.
crates/frf-gateway/src/main.rs:237 logs CDC task errors and drops the task result while HTTP readiness continues.
findings.impact: A full-profile instance can be placed in rotation while it is no longer consuming committed source changes, contradicting c004 readiness truthfulness and c003's full-profile boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Expose CDC/Postgres liveness to AppState readiness or supervise CDC as a fatal/NotReady component; add a negative test where CDC_ENABLED=true and Postgres/replication fails after startup, expecting /readyz 503.

findings.title: Kubernetes SSR TLS is declared but not fail-closed by the renderer or readiness evidence
findings.claim: Compose validates cert/key/CA material before render, but the SSR Kubernetes renderer only substitutes image and host; missing or invalid frf-shape-tls is delegated to the environment and is not proven to fail startup/readiness.
evidence: openspec/changes/pri-c004-deployment-profiles/design.md:38 requires TLS sources and invalid or missing TLS inputs to fail startup/readiness.
k8s/overlays/ssr/ingress.yaml:10 declares TLS and ingress.yaml:12 hard-codes secretName frf-shape-tls.
k8s/overlays/ssr/render-profile.sh:5-12 validates only FRF_SHAPE_GATEWAY_IMAGE and FRF_PUBLIC_HOST.
.kbd-orchestrator/phases/production-readiness-integration/evidence/pri-c004-deployment-profiles/acceptance-b.md:51-56 records dry-run plus image/host negatives only for SSR.
findings.impact: The Compose and Kubernetes profile gates are inconsistent; SSR can render a manifest whose TLS prerequisite is absent or wrong without the c004 evidence catching it.
findings.suggested_fix: Either make the SSR renderer take and verify a concrete TLS secret/cert source in a local kind fixture, or narrow c004 to a template declaration and move TLS fail-closed proof to a named environment release receipt.

findings.title: The OpenSpec archive gate remains open while required review resolution is pending
findings.claim: c004 has a receipt and local validation evidence, but its final task is still unchecked and now has a critical review finding to resolve.
evidence: openspec instructions apply reported progress 4/5 during this review.
findings.impact: The change should not archive until the critical readiness finding is fixed and the final evidence/review task is updated.
findings.suggested_fix: After fixing readiness and re-running local checks, update task 5 and re-run this review or an equivalent fresh-context review.
